newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-AUSTRALIA V BORDER TOSS AND TEAMS.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-AUSTRALIA V BORDER TOSS AND TEAMS.

text.p: Australian captain Ian Healy won the toss and chose to put Border in to bat on the first day of their three day game on Friday.

Healy assumed the captaincy from Mark Taylor who has rested himself, fast bowler Glenn McGrath and Steve Waugh for the last first class game before the second test which begins in Port Elizabeth next Friday.
Australia - Matthew Elliott, Matthew Hayden, Michael Bevan, Greg Blewett, Mark Waugh, Justin Langer, Ian Healy (captain), Paul Reiffel, Shane Warne, Andy Bichel, Jason Gillespie.
Border - Piet Botha, Brad White, Craig Wilson, Peter Kirsten, Mark Boucher, Piet Strydom (captain), Steven Pope, Ian Howell, Dion Taljard, Peter Emslie, Makhaya Ntini.
